description: Turns wallet auto-recharge on or off. When on, Spur charges the saved card amount_usd whenever the balance drops below threshold_usd, so sends never fail for lack of funds. Needs a saved card (the first spur_top_up_wallet payment saves one). Turning it on needs the user's approval of the amount and threshold (confirm=true); turning it off doesn't.

amount_usd.description: Amount added per recharge (required when enabling, minimum $5)

confirm.description: Required to enable: true ONLY after the user approved automatic charges of this amount at this threshold.

enabled.description: true = turn auto-recharge on, false = off

threshold_usd.description: Recharge when the balance drops below this (required when enabling; lower than amount_usd)

name: spur_set_auto_recharge
title: Auto-recharge
